capabilities.summary: Discover versioned functionality exposed by this build.
Evaluate recognized resume section coverage with explainable deterministic checks.
Analyze resume readiness with 18 explainable deterministic checks and confidence-aware evidence.
Normalize bounded resume text into source-grounded deterministic facts and confidence.
Validate and conservatively merge an explicit source-grounded external proposal without network access.
Review bounded external suggestions against a freshly rerun deterministic analysis without changing it.
Review bounded exact external replacements against a freshly rerun deterministic analysis without changing it.
Review bounded evidence-linked external resume changes without certifying generated prose.
Revalidate and deterministically materialize only explicitly selected assisted resume changes.
Normalize bounded job-description text into source-grounded deterministic facts and confidence.
Match deterministic resume and job baselines with conservative equivalence and confidence-aware evidence.
